title: Obsidian.Current.S01E08.2026.1080p.WEB-DL.H264-TESTGRP
description: RAR5 store-method set with data encryption and PAR2 recovery, damaged by deleting the tail articles of an interior volume. Parity covers the archive bytes as posted - the ciphertext - so repair rewrites encrypted bytes in place while the clean volumes stay virtual, with no key involved anywhere in the chain. Extraction with the password is the proof: it fails on anything but byte-exact repaired ciphertext.
